name: pcba-engineering
description: Prepare, reconcile, revise and independently verify local PCBA assembly packages.

interface.longDescription: Reconcile PCB assembly data, preview bounded changes, and export a traceable offline assembly guide with independent artifact readback. Source and assembly views share the same board geometry. Material readiness and manufacturing authorization remain explicit.
defaultPrompt: Use $review-pcba-package to review my BOM and placement package and show the assembly findings.
Use $revise-pcba-assembly to preview a bounded correction using my authoritative placement data.
Use $prepare-pcba-handoff to export and independently verify the current assembly packet.
